title: Noor and the Kitchen
author: Jude Montrose
blurb: Silas Underhill, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
